// ruleid: in-process-cache-javascript
import { LRUCache } from "lru-cache";

const WORD = /\w+/;
const SPLIT = new RegExp(",");

export class Parser {
  static WORD = /\w+/;

  parse(text: string) {
    // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
    return /a+b/.test(text);
  }
}

export function words(text: string, pattern: string, total: number, parts: number) {
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
  const found = /a+b/i.test(text);
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
  const global = /x/i.test(text) && /day/g.test(text) && /x/gi.test(text) && text.replace(/x/gu, "") === "";
  const ratio = total / parts / 2;
  const path = "Error: /tmp/ is missing"; // see /docs/ for more
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
  const built = new RegExp("a+b");
  const dynamic = new RegExp(pattern);
  // ruleid: bool-array-javascript
  const seen = new Array(text.length).fill(false);
  return [found, global, ratio, path, built, dynamic, seen, WORD, SPLIT, LRUCache];
}

export async function load(session: Db, db: Db, users: Db, orders: Db, ids: string[], base: string, links: Link[]) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.get(id);
  }
  for await (const row of db.stream()) {
    await db.put(row);
  }
  for await (const row of db.stream()) await db.put(row);
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.remove(id);
  }
  while (true) {
    await db.take();
  }
  let cursor = await db.page("");
  while (cursor) {
    cursor = await db.page(cursor);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (await db.has(id)) {
      break;
    }
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    await db.put(id);
    await sleep(100);
  }
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
  const first = await users.get("a");
  const second = await orders.get("b");
  console.log(second);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
  const user = await db.get("a");
  const org = await db.get("b");
  console.log(org);
  const left = await session.get("a");
  const right = await session.get("b");
  const total = first + second;
  const third = await db.get(total);
  const fourth = await db.get(third);
  // ruleid: url-parse-in-loop-javascript
  const same = ids.map((id) => new URL(base).host === id);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const trimmed = id.trim();
    same.push(new URL(trimmed).host === base);
  }
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(links)) {
    same.push(new URL(value).host === key);
  }
  return [fourth, user, org, left, right, same, ids.map((id) => new URL(id).host), links.map(({ href }) => new URL(href))];
}

export function queries(db: Db, prisma: Prisma, supabase: Supabase, args: object) {
  return [
    // ruleid: whole-row-query-javascript
    supabase.from("users").select("*"),
    supabase.from("users").select("id,name"),
    // ruleid: whole-row-query-javascript
    db.select().from(usersTable),
    db.select({ id: usersTable.id }).from(usersTable),
    // ruleid: whole-row-query-javascript
    prisma.user.findMany({ where: { active: true } }),
    prisma.user.findMany({ where: { active: true }, select: { id: true } }),
    prisma.user.findMany(args),
    // ruleid: json-column-javascript
    jsonb("settings"),
    db.response.json(),
    db.header("application/json"),
    // ruleid: json-column-javascript
    db.raw("SELECT data->>'k' FROM users"),
    db.raw("INSERT INTO archive SELECT * FROM users"),
    db.raw("SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)"),
    // ruleid: whole-row-sql
    db.raw("SELECT * FROM users"),
  ];
}
